items.title: Angelo Elia - The Bakery Bar
items.html:
A true Italian feel - Angelo Elia's Bakery Bar is a wonderful and quaint pastry shop that is walkable from the home. Take a stroll through the neighborhood (only a couple blocks south) and come back with a delicious cappuccino and chocolate croissant.

Phone: 954-566-6100

Address: 2104 E Oakland Park Blvd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33306

Hours: Mon–Thu and Sun 7am–6pm, Fri–Sat 7am–7pm

Website: https://angeloeliabakery.com/

items.title: Cafe Brie
items.html:
An exquisite breakfast menu including phenomenal crepes, omelets, French toast, and more. The owners/servers are hands down the most hospitable folks we've encountered in South Florida. Cafe Brie is a simple, welcoming family environment and the perfect place to stop before you head to Pompano Beach Pier. 

Phone: 954-532-7800

Address: 2765 E Atlantic Blvd, Pompano Beach, FL 33062

items.title: Rendez-Vous Bakery and Bistro
items.html:
From France to South Florida...literally; it's right around the corner. This amazing French Bakery has wonderful outdoor seating and a delicious menu from top to bottom.

Phone: 954-563-2228

Address: 1576 E Oakland Park Blvd, Oakland Park, FL 33334

Hours: Breakfast 8–11:30am, lunch 11:30am–5pm, dinner from 5pm

Website: https://www.rdvbakery.com

items.title: Tinta
items.html:
This wonderful place is oceanside, covered, outdoors, and one of our absolute favorites! Tinta is a Mexican breakfast down on Fort Lauderdale central beach (inside the Westin Fort Lauderdale Beach Resort). It's a bit of a drive from our home, but the breakfast quesadilla or machaca skillet is totally worth it!

Phone: 954-245-3063

Address: 321 N Fort Lauderdale Beach Blvd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304

Hours: Daily 7am–11am (breakfast only)

Website: https://www.lonarestaurant.com/waterfront-restaurants-fort-lauderdale/tinta-breakfast

items.title: Casablanca Cafe
items.html:
Designed in Mediterranean Revival architecture, the house is an eclectic blend of architectural elements of Spanish and Middle Eastern origins. Casablanca Cafe offers chef-inspired Mediterranean cuisine set to a charming and welcoming feel, created in part by the restaurant building itself - a nostalgic residential home built in the 1920s. Casablanca Cafe has been serving the community with unrivaled service and an unmatched dinner experience.

Phone: 954-764-3500

Address: 3049 Alhambra St, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304

Hours: Mon–Thu and Sun 8:30am–10pm, Fri–Sat 8:30am–11pm

https://casablancacafeonline.com/

items.title: Only Thai
items.html:
Location, authenticity, service, and quality. Only Thai is just down the street and an absolute must-get. Whether you're looking to dine in or grab something to go - this place leaves us satisfied every single time.

Phone: 954-908-5578

Address: 2100 E Oakland Park Blvd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33306

Hours: Open daily from 11:30am (lunch specials Mon–Fri until 3pm); call to confirm afternoon/evening hours

Website: https://otthai.com/

items.title: Tacocraft Taqueria & Tequila Bar
items.html:
Modern Mexican restaurant with lots of energy and good vibes. The chips and salsa are a classic delicious starter with tons of amazing taco choices. It can get a little pricey since it is located in Lauderdale By The Sea so we recommend going during Happy Hour (daily 3–6pm and 10pm–close)!

Phone: 954-530-3763

Address: 4400 N Ocean Dr, Lauderdale-By-The-Sea, FL 33308

Hours: Mon, Wed, Thu 11:30am–11pm; Tue and Fri 11:30am–midnight; Sat 11am–midnight; Sun 11am–11pm

https://tacocraft.com/lauderdale-by-the-sea/

items.title: Craft Food Tours - Fort Lauderdale
items.html:
Escape the South Florida tourist traps as your local guides take you through Fort Lauderdale, Florida for an afternoon of food and drinks. Adults receive 8+ tastings and 2 alcoholic beverages, with vendor demonstrations and much more! The downtown tour runs about 3 hours (11am–2pm); beach and dinner & drinks tours are also offered.

Phone: 954-352-2336

Website: https://www.craftfoodtours.com/fort-lauderdale/

items.title: Plantation Preserve Golf Course & Club
items.html:
South Florida’s finest public golf facility, which opened in February 2006, is unlike any other in the South Florida area. You will find a very challenging 18-hole championship golf course, a beautiful clubhouse with stunning panoramic views, and state of the art practice facilities.

Tee times: 954-585-5020

Address: 7050 W Broward Blvd, Plantation, FL 33317

Plantation Preserve website

items.title: Pompano Beach Golf Club
items.html:
https://parks.pompanobeachfl.gov/golf

The recently renovated and redesigned Pines Championship Golf Course is an 18-hole course featuring over 7,100 yards and a par of 72. The adjacent Palms Course is a traditional Florida course challenging golfers of all skill levels. It is 18 holes, par 71, and over 6,280 yards. The Palms golf course caters to a loyal following of golfers who have enjoyed the layout for over a half a century.

Pro shop: 954-781-0426

Address: 1101 N Federal Hwy, Pompano Beach, FL 33062

Hours: Daily 6:30am–6pm

items.title: Palm Aire Country Club
items.html:
https://palmaire.clublink.com/

Palm Aire Country Club in Pompano Beach, Florida, has a rich history dating back to its opening in 1959. Originally a country club featuring golf, it quickly grew into a master-planned community. Legendary golfer Sam Snead set a course record of 65 here in 1962. Today the club has three 18-hole courses (The Palms, The Oaks and The Cypress) and welcomes public golfers.

Phone: 954-978-1737

Address: 3701 Oaks Clubhouse Dr, Pompano Beach, FL 33069

items.title: BlueFoot Pirate Adventures
items.html:
An interactive pirate cruise that offers a family-friendly sail on the Intracoastal Waterway. The crew shares tips on how to talk and dress like a pirate, find hidden treasure, and fend off rival pirate attacks. Face painting, temporary tattoos, and onboard water cannons add to the fun, and kids receive a bag of loot and a pirate certificate to take home. A 21+ sunset cruise is also offered.

Departs: Dania Beach Marina, Dock G28, 151 N Beach Rd, Dania Beach, FL 33004

Phone: 954-530-8302

https://www.bluefootpirates.com/

items.title: Florida Everglades Airboat Adventure and Wildlife Encounter
items.html:
Escape to the Florida Everglades for this airboat adventure and wildlife encounter at Sawgrass Recreation Park. This exciting airboat ride is a great way to experience the unique subtropical ecosystem of the Everglades as you skim across the grassy water.

Address: 1006 N US Highway 27, Weston, FL 33327

Phone: 954-389-0202

Hours: Airboats run every 20–30 minutes until 3:30pm, with a final ride at 5pm (weather permitting; call ahead)

https://www.evergladestours.com/
